svg.title: Attention heads, stacked in parallel
svg.desc: Attention heads drawn as a 3D stack of sheets, one behind another. The same input, 5 tokens by 768 numbers, feeds every sheet at once. Each sheet is one head with its own look-back grid, where later words are masked: head 1 links back to "cat", head 2 looks at the previous word, head 3 at the first word, head 4 at itself, head 5 spreads its attention, head 6 looks two words back; the stack continues up to head 12. All heads’ outputs are joined (12 × 64 = 768) and mixed into an output of 5 by 768. Numbers from GPT-2.
svg.text: Each sheet is one head with its own look-back pattern. All read the same input at once.
Numbers from GPT-2: 12 heads, 64 numbers each. Darker cells = more attention; grey = later words, masked.
